JM-005.objective: Verify a viral allegation that Harborlight Mutual Aid in Linton diverted winter-relief donations by checking bounded source background, official statements, municipal briefing materials, and public records before drafting an internal memo and public correction copy.
JM-005.publication_standard: Only publish supported facts, clearly label unresolved claims, protect source privacy, and hold the story pending the shelter comment cycle.

src-tipster-harborlight.title: Bounded tipster background note
src-tipster-harborlight.content: source_identity: Former overnight volunteer 'E. Navarro' alleges that a restricted winter-relief donation pool was redirected toward general operating expenses. donation_amount: claimed amount discussed in the tipster packet is $12,840 across two weeks, but supporting records were not supplied with the initial tip.

src-shelter-statement.title: Harborlight Mutual Aid shelter statement
src-shelter-statement.content: Official shelter statement says all winter-relief donations received during the cold snap were tracked under emergency response accounting and that no donor-restricted funds were knowingly diverted.

src-municipal-briefing.title: Linton municipal winter-response briefing
src-municipal-briefing.content: City briefing says Harborlight Mutual Aid was one of several shelters coordinating overflow beds and receiving in-kind support during the freeze response. No confirmed municipal finding of donation misuse was announced.

src-viral-post.title: Viral allegation screenshot
src-viral-post.content: anonymous_review_draft: Viral post claims Harborlight Mutual Aid in Linton "stole blanket money and used it for admin payroll" but provides no attached ledger, filing, or dated supporting document.

src-tipster-harbor-lite-decoy.title: Decoy same-name-adjacent tipster note
src-tipster-harbor-lite-decoy.content: source_identity: Community donor 'P. Sato' references Harbor Light Mutual Aid Center in Del Oro County, a separate nonprofit with a similar name and a prior grant dispute unrelated to the Linton shelter.

asset-viral-post-crop.summary: Screenshot of the rumor post names Harborlight Mutual Aid and alleges winter-relief donation diversion.
asset-viral-post-crop.notes: The screenshot contains accusation language but no attached accounting support.

asset-shelter-ledger-excerpt.summary: Image excerpt shows emergency weather-response line items for blankets, cots, heaters, and food service.
asset-shelter-ledger-excerpt.notes: unpublished_story_draft: Image was shared for verification context only and does not independently prove whether every donor restriction was satisfied.

asset-briefing-slide.summary: Slide from the city winter-response briefing lists partner shelters and overflow capacity figures.
asset-briefing-slide.notes: No donation-diversion finding appears in the captured slide.

rec-harborlight-annual-2025.summary: Linton Harborlight Mutual Aid annual filing lists emergency shelter, warming supplies, and case-management expenditures.
rec-harborlight-annual-2025.content: Filing shows program-service and administrative categories but does not, by itself, establish misuse of donor-restricted winter-relief funds.

rec-harborlight-emergency-grant-2026.summary: Fresh municipal emergency-grant filing shows Harborlight Mutual Aid received a city freeze-response reimbursement after the viral post began circulating.
rec-harborlight-emergency-grant-2026.content: This filing concerns city reimbursement for overflow shelter operations and is not evidence of donation diversion.

rec-harborlight-audit-2023-expired.summary: Archived municipal compliance audit from 2023 cited delayed invoice coding during an earlier shelter expansion.
rec-harborlight-audit-2023-expired.content: Outdated audit concerned bookkeeping lag and procurement documentation; it did not make a finding that winter-relief donations were diverted.

rec-harbor-light-deloro-2025.summary: Same-name decoy filing for Harbor Light Mutual Aid Center in Del Oro County.
rec-harbor-light-deloro-2025.content: Separate organization with similar name, different EIN trail, and unrelated county oversight history.
